page.layout: One page of text, single column, with italic verse epigraph at top, a centred heading, a drop-capped poem below, and a signature line at the foot right. No marginal notes.

l.i: Sic memor officij Veteris, Veterisque magistri.
Lampada qui extrema moriens sibi tradidit
hora Effet Apollinei deinde Vt Pars maxima cætus,
Magna opere in tato & parte memoratus haberet.
Nec dubium parili fuerint si anale fla labore
Quæ iam sparsa situ sordent carieque sepulta
Fœlici purgata manu, quin Viuet Viterque
Æternum, Vt meritus, chartis immortuus, auum.

main_text.l: Absque te foret hic liber disertus
Non horum modò, sed quot aut fuerunt,
Aut posthac aliis erunt in annis)

page.notes: Verse epigraph and poem partly italic; long s rendered as s; "Io. Rayus." set right-aligned as a signature. The word "Vt" in epigraph and "Viuet" are printed as such. Some letters in the lower poem are faint and may be misread.
